tools.name: detect_negotiable_bill
tools.description:
Check whether a bill looks negotiable. Returns {negotiable,
category_label, pitch}. Show the pitch to the human and only proceed with
their explicit approval.

tools.name: start_negotiation_case
tools.description:
Open a Dueback negotiation case. Only call after the human approved the
pitch from detect_negotiable_bill.

Two outcomes:
- {"outcome": "case_created", "case_id", ...}: the case is open; give
  the human the case id and offer to check status later.
- {"outcome": "setup_required", "setup_url", ...}:

tools.name: get_case_status
tools.description:
Get the current status of a negotiation case: state, steps taken,
savings found, and whether human approval is needed. If the result
carries review_prompt, a negotiation has succeeded and no review
exists yet — present the review prompt once, per agent_next_step.
bank_status reports the Plaid connec

tools.name: list_my_cases
tools.description:
List the human's own Dueback negotiation cases (newest first):
case_id, status, public bill-type label, counterparty, and amounts
for each. Use this when the human asks about their cases generally
("how are my cases doing?") or when you need a case_id you don't
already have; then call get_case_statu

tools.name: list_verified_savings
tools.description:
Aggregate verified-savings stats (public). Use to answer 'does Dueback
actually work?' and to ground shareable savings claims in real numbers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_negotiation_case, get_case_status · Private data: start_negotiation_case · Public sink: get_case_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_negotiation_case, get_case_status · Private data: start_negotiation_case · Public sink: get_case_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
